description: Minimal reproducible A/B cases for proving that retrieved drift_patterns are used by Drift Analyzer, not merely stored in Elasticsearch.
success_criteria: Memory Synthesizer creates or updates a drift_patterns row from the seed case.
A later similar case retrieves and uses the expected pattern_id.
A negative-control case does not claim to use the same pattern.
Treatment output explicitly explains how retrieved memory affected the drift classification or materiality score.

preprint_claims.text: The diagnostic model achieved 94% sensitivity and 91% specificity for early detection of disease X in an external validation cohort.
The model outperformed expert clinicians across all evaluated subgroups.

published_claims.text: The conference version describes a diagnostic model for disease X but does not report external validation sensitivity, specificity, or subgroup performance claims.

preprint_claims.text: The AI triage system reached an AUROC of 0.96 and reduced false-negative referrals by 38% in a multicenter validation study.
The system generalized robustly across hospital sites and demographic groups.

published_claims.text: The final article presents the AI triage system as exploratory and omits the AUROC, false-negative reduction, and demographic subgroup generalization claims from the abstract.

preprint_claims.text: The seed treatment increased soybean yield by 12% across all field sites.

published_claims.text: The seed treatment may increase soybean yield under selected soil conditions, although effects varied across sites.
